summary: Hardened the DXVK runtime analyzer so apparent host-owned DirectGPU frames cannot become a promotion-grade ACTIVE verdict unless exact-build source/backend identity is verified, package-integrity evidence is verified, host/import bridge generations agree, the host-owned direct path is active, and DirectFrames>0. Incomplete or unverified evidence fails closed with explicit blockers; host/import generation mismatch has its own status.

review.architecture: This task only changes post-session evidence classification. It composes previously separate CONVERSION-DXVK-00015 bridge telemetry, CONVERSION-DXVK-00019 exact-build identity and CONVERSION-DXVK-00021 package-integrity evidence into one promotion-evidence trust gate.
review.lifetime_sync: Host/import generation mismatch is now an explicit evidence blocker. The underlying producer/consumer resource lifetime, fences, ACK ordering and bridge implementation are unchanged.
review.stereo_correctness: No renderer, WVP, HUD/menu, recenter or visual path changed.
review.performance: No game/host hot-path code changed. Trust evaluation happens only in the post-session analyzer.
review.adversarial: Synthetic directFrames>0 cases prove that incomplete identity, unverified package integrity and mismatched bridge generations cannot emit DXVK_HOST_OWNED_DIRECTGPU_ACTIVE.

behavior_verified: Trusted fixture with matching session/build/preflight identity, PackageIntegrity.Verified=true, matching host/import generation, host-owned path active and DirectFrames=240 emits DXVK_HOST_OWNED_DIRECTGPU_ACTIVE and DxvkDirectEvidenceTrusted=true.
DirectFrames=240 with incomplete identity emits DXVK_DIRECTGPU_EVIDENCE_UNTRUSTED and blockers BUILD_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED plus PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_EVIDENCE_MISSING.
DirectFrames=240 with PackageIntegrity.Verified=false emits DXVK_DIRECTGPU_EVIDENCE_UNTRUSTED and blocker PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_NOT_VERIFIED.
DirectFrames=240 with host bridge generation 12345 and game import generation 54321 emits DXVK_HOST_GENERATION_MISMATCH and blocker HOST_IMPORT_GENERATION_MISMATCH.
Concrete build identity mismatch retains higher-precedence DXVK_BUILD_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and remains untrusted.
regression_revalidation: VR-DXVK-D3D9EX-SHARED-HANDLE-001: remains OPEN_USER_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_FAILURE; this task changes only evidence trust/classification.
